concerns_addressed: The human waiver explicitly accepts the missing historical RED-before-production evidence for T2-C04 and T2-C05. No historical event was fabricated; final Project replacement, incompatible-Phase clearing, and Project-removal cascade behavior were verified in the reducer and passing tests.

The human waiver explicitly accepts the missing separately recorded T2-C07 baseline/post timing. No timing evidence was fabricated; the final regression test was inspected and passed, including DST-oriented, month-end, and year-end calendar cases.

T2-C01 through T2-C08 final behavior was verified: single-value replacement, multi-value toggle/deduplication, Phase-to-Project inference, Project/Phase cascades, date-fns local-calendar presets, and non-destructive invalid Tracker date-range handling.

The cumulative range contains exactly the two declared T2 files and no extra dependency or behavior scope was introduced. The focused packet suite passed 8 tests under the default timezone and America/New_York, and root typecheck passed.

strengths: The reducer and payload selector provide one deterministic metadata state source with normalized single-value fields and deduplicated relation IDs.
Project/Phase invariants and invalid date-range preservation are implemented with explicit reducer transitions and meaningful assertions.
Date presets use date-fns addDays and format for local calendar arithmetic rather than UTC-hour arithmetic.
The two new files remain below the approximately 300-line file and 50-line function heuristics, with no repeated logic requiring a rule-of-three extraction.
The implementation adds no dependencies, preserves client import conventions, and the final focused tests exercise all eight declared scenarios.

issues.description: The two T2 files are not formatter-clean under the repository Biome configuration; Biome reports formatting-only changes. This is non-blocking and does not affect the verified behavior.
